name: incident-scope
label: Incident Picker
author: Whitewater Rescue Institute
description: Incident picker for the incident maps. Lists the open incidents from the WRI incident registry and, on a pick, re-filters every incident-scoped layer on the live map to that incident (the same project-style filters the activation runner rewrites), adds that client's extra layers (client layer packs), zooms to the incident and tells the other widgets and panels. Deep-links with ?incident=<id or project name>; remembers the last pick per device. With one incident open it is just a name chip.
